nom: ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist

avis.texte: I've gone through countless bottles of this mist, I simply can't live without it! The second I notice I'm running low, I immediately run out to buy another one! I use it before my skincare, after my skincare, before makeup, and even after makeup. It's incredibly hydrating and gives my skin the most beautiful glow without feeling oily or greasy. It's perfect for all skin types, especially for my perimenopausal skin. This has become an absolute must-have in my routine. 100% recommend! ✨
within 2 days my face had pimples - I NEVER BREAK OUT. Horrible.

I have senaitive and reactive skin, combo/dry, rosacea, acne prone, and facing weinkes at 48 - and this is amazing! Its lightweight but hydrating. Other sprays are heavy and sit on the skin - not this!

man I truly wanted to love this. I used it 3 times and the first 2 gave such great results but by application 3 I was covered in red almost welts from something in this... I do have sensitive skin, so it might be OK for people without sensitive skin. but if you're sensitive skip this one

I barely ever review a product because they don't often work as advertised, but this is a very welcome exception! I specifically used this before and after putting on make up - as a primer and setting spray. I've never had my skin turn out so well! I used concealer to cover some acne and red spots, and when I took it off at the end of the day it was almost entirely cleared up!? like it actually helped my skin WHILE I was wearing make up, and usually the opposite happens. PLUS! It made my make up look better - no caking! Insane only odd thing is it feels a little oily after putting it on, but it goes away after a few minutes.
i bought this to replace rhode glazing mist, but its not as hydrating or glowy as i thought. it just feels like water going on my face. will not be repurchasing.
Highly recommend product. Feels refreshing and does not irritate my skin since I do have sensitive skin and will break out with anything put onto my face.

It leaves the skin looking incredibly radiant. I loved the final result. It provides wonderful hydration. I recommend this product for all skin types; I even use it on my husband, and his skin looks great after application. It doesn't leave the skin feeling greasy and works perfectly under makeup, too.
It's a nice product. I would like dare I say a bit more moisturizing? I love how my makeup looks after a spritz.

With so many products out there and with the marketing on them being so good you just never know what to trust or what you need for your specific skin. There was a makeup influencer who recommended this product and because I have messed up My skin barrier I am looking for all things hydration. And when I tell you I went through a half bottle in about a week and a half that is no exaggeration. I am SO happy that I tried this. Again you have to get what works for your skin, so I am just here to tell you my experience that it has calmed and hydrated my skin so nicely. I have even been using it on my neck and chest and I have seen huge improvements there is well. My skin is very sensitive and gets irritated very easily and this has made such a difference in calming down the redness, making my skin look calm and glowing, making it look more even and has worked nicely with my other products. I even spray it throughout the day when I feel my face is getting hot. I highly recommend if you are looking for pure hydration.
I love the anua products and i can adjust them according to my skins changes. I see a difference and i look at me every day.

I didnt realize my skin needed this hydrating product. Saw it recommended online- gave it a go for the price. I have dry skin year round and this has helped hydrate my skin so much. Sensitive eyes due to rosacea but this product has not been an issue. Really happy to have found this product line.

I bought this product after seeing it advertised online by different influencers that I watch. When I tried this product, it made my face break out immediately. It made my face itchy, and it felt like it was burning. For about a week, my face was broke out in a rash.

I had high hopes for this based on the Internet and social media hype but it's just a basic face mist that actually takes quite a bit of product to hydrate my face. There are so many great mists on the market - I wouldn't purchase this again.
been using for about a month after given as a rec from an ulta associate! feels light, refreshing, and melts my makeup. was cheaper than I expected and I'm happy with it!
